description: Personal data is collected for specified purposes but processed for incompatible purposes without proper justification. Data must only be used for purposes that are compatible with the original collection purpose.
applicability: Applicable to all personal data processing where data may be used for purposes beyond original collection. Includes data sharing, secondary analytics, and repurposing of collected data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of records of processing activities, data flows, and purpose documentation. Compare stated collection purposes against actual processing activities.
